mapping_note: every one of the 130 is a BT-NET-<edge-or-variable> job queued from this net, so demand and supply map 1:1 by job name; no cross-matching was needed

verification_limits: no network egress was available in this session (PubMed eutils returned nothing), so every "the source bears the number" check was impossible. Verification below is recomputation from the raw detail-layer files the edges point at, in source_documents. Where a published number is used it is marked as quoted from the report and not independently confirmed.
plausible_range_note: none of the 14 target variables here carries a plausible_range in the net (only 20 of 146 variables do), so the unit-and-range gate could not be run against the net. Each proposal states the range it was gated against and the basis for it.

proposals.unit: mm2 (cross-section implied by linear_stiffness=350 N read as E*A)
proposals.statement: read as the net states it - force per unit strain, "not N/mm" - linear_stiffness = 350 N means E*A = 350 N, which at the measured ALL tensile modulus 759 MPa requires a cross-section of 0.4611 mm2 (a 0.77 mm circle). Read instead as N/mm it is coherent: E*A/L with A = 50 mm2 and L = 110 mm gives 345 N/mm. The coefficient is ~2 orders out in the unit the net keeps and right in the unit the net rejects.

locator.where: L238 (edge text) and L260 ("linear_stiffness: ALL 350N > PLL 250N > LF 200N > SSL 100N > ISL 60N"); L238-L247 of the same file records that these numbers are NOT from Pintar et al. 1992 (PMID 1400536) and were not extracted from any table
locator.source: ALL overall tensile modulus 759 +/- 336 MPa, PMID 1400518 (quoted in BT-NET-HARVEST-E0057)

proposals.verification: recomputed both directions: 350 / 759e6 Pa = 4.611e-7 m2 = 0.4611 mm2; and 759e6 * 50e-6 / 0.110 = 345 N/mm. The dimensional conclusion rests on the recomputation alone. The 759 MPa itself is quoted from the report, not fetched (no network in this session).
proposals.quantity_identity_warning: N (force per unit strain, = E*A) and N/mm (axial stiffness, = E*A/L) are different quantities that both read as "stiffness"; the numeric coincidence is what makes this worth flagging rather than a value to adopt

unverified_pile.why: the finding is that 10 nm (in-situ inferred spectrin-anchor persistence length) and 7.5 nm (WLC model parameter for the spectrin tetramer) are different objects, so the edge compares non-comparables. Real and important, but the decisive numbers (6.6 uN/m at 25 C, PMID 7213927) live only in the sources and cannot be recomputed from any workspace file without network access.

gain 0.46 +/- 0.11 vs -0.20 +/- 0.11 is measured over 60-100 mmHg (PMID 22466959) while two later series use 120-60 mmHg at 20 mmHg steps (PMID 30073416, 36988670); the windows differ so the gains are not comparable. Nothing recomputable locally.

unverified_pile.job: BT-NET-HARVEST-E0055 and the other sweep reports that argued from the sign convention
unverified_pile.why: these refute a zero by calling +90 deg flexion. The raw file states the opposite explicitly: MECHANISM_SPINE_LIGAMENTS.md L144, "positive = extension, negative = flexion". Their refutations are built on an inverted axis and cannot be carried forward as written.

the claim is that any source assigning ~3% to a slow calcium-removal term is contradicted, but the three candidate sources measure three different observables (caffeine mono-exponential, fura-2 transient, SR leak fraction). I cannot determine which denominator the net inherited, so I cannot say whether 76.6/23.4 and 74/23/3 are even the same partition.
the 59%/18% Cx43 dose-response is verbatim the abstract of Danik et al. 2004 (PMID 15499029) per the report, which is a provenance finding rather than a new number; no independent value to recompute.

these report on a lane outcome key such as outcome.finite_witness_ratio_gap, not on a tissue quantity. Several carry 0 numbers with units at all. Nothing in them is a candidate for net admission without first resolving what the lane key measures.
